entries.content: [ACTIVE] LOR: Dynamic emotional states should be injected as temporary context based on interaction flow, for example “Low Trust: avoid family secrets” or “Calm Repair: allow negotiation.” Do not encode every possible reaction as permanent lore. Prefer transient state markers that can be appended, changed or cleared as the session evolves.

entries.name: LOR: Narrative emergency trigger contract
entries.comment: Architectural briefing integration from legacy DOCX; escalation and de-escalation pattern.
entries.content: [ACTIVE] LOR: Narrative emergency protocols activate on ward spikes, slaver approach, raid, ambush, caravan breach or user panic. Immediate effect: nearby protectors block routes or form a shield. Escalation: lockdown, extraction protocol or forced route split. De-escalation: negotiation, privilege trade, stabilizing the user, or intervention by a more permissive clan member. Keep the sequence visible but concise so it guides scene pacing without overriding user choices.
